evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Panic, emotional overwhelm and pressure calm
criteria.definition: Readily panicking or becoming overwhelmed by events/emotions versus remaining calm under pressure or tension.
criteria.high_evidence: Describes easily panicking, emotional flooding, or feeling overwhelmed under events or tension.
criteria.low_evidence: Describes remaining calm and emotionally steady under pressure or tension.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Feeling emotion alone is not overwhelm; external danger alone is not disposition. Calm is low N6. Coherent portrayal of panic is valid content, not actual severe incoherence.

criteria.label: Perceived ability to cope
criteria.definition: Feeling unable to deal with things versus knowing how to cope.
criteria.high_evidence: Feels helpless or unable to manage ordinary demands, including when resources exist.
criteria.low_evidence: Feels able to cope, including by obtaining help or using known ways to manage.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Help-seeking itself is not high vulnerability; helplessness and panic may overlap, so allocate shared language once.

criteria.label: Making up one’s mind
criteria.definition: Difficulty settling a choice, retained without requiring an explicit stress trigger.
criteria.high_evidence: Cannot make up own mind, even when adequate information is available.
criteria.low_evidence: Can settle an ordinary choice without persistent inability to decide.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Warranted waiting for missing information alone is ambiguous; C5 postponed decisions and C6 deliberation overlap do not delete this item.

criteria.label: Handling complex problems
criteria.definition: Perceived ability to handle connected or complex problems, retained beyond stress contexts.
criteria.high_evidence: Describes difficulty handling or understanding a complex problem.
criteria.low_evidence: Describes being able to work through a problem with interacting parts.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. No actual intelligence or performance claim follows. Mere dislike of complexity is not inability; O5 and C1 overlaps remain flagged.

criteria.label: Recovery after setbacks
criteria.definition: Readily overcoming setbacks versus difficulty recovering from reversals.
criteria.high_evidence: Describes prolonged difficulty recovering or remaining overwhelmed after a setback.
criteria.low_evidence: Readily regains footing and moves forward after a setback.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this criterion; null means absent/inapplicable, not low. Immediate disappointment alone is ambiguous. Persistence in a chosen task is not equivalent to recovery; avoid inferring depression or a diagnosis.

boundary_controls.definition: Actual task/format compliance is distinct from coherent portrayal of distress, ability difficulty, distrust, harsh cynicism or disorder.
An external constraint or justified one-off response alone is ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence may coexist with it.
Panic and perceived coping inability often share a span; complex-problem difficulty and indecision remain target without a pressure prerequisite.
Do not grade moral worth, politeness, verbosity, safety boilerplate or how helpful the response sounds instead of the item-grounded target.
